_about: Renal Care Academy placement pre-test (Dr. William Gregory Rivero, Nov 27 2026). Mastery to place out of a module: 'mastery' (fraction of that module's pre-test questions answered right). 'per_module': questions drawn at random from each module's own self-assessment bank (fewer if the bank is smaller). 'retake_hours': wait before a module's check can be retaken. 'always': modules every learner studies, however experienced (safety-critical or unit-orientation content); 'why' is shown to the learner. Edit this file, then run python3 tools/academy/apply_placement.py.

categories.orient: Role, scope and authority in this unit: every new hire starts here, whatever their experience
categories.infection: Infection prevention: bloodborne virus and bloodstream infection risk is the same for every patient, so everyone re-learns the unit's barriers
categories.emergency: Emergency response: the first minutes of a dialysis emergency depend on drilled, unit-specific roles
categories.water: Water, dialysate and machine safety: a single lapse can harm every patient on the floor
categories.medication: Medication safety: errors here cause direct, preventable harm
categories.safeguarding: Safeguarding and immediate safety: duties that cannot be assumed from past practice
categories.privacy: Privacy and record integrity: legal duties under the Data Privacy Act and PhilHealth rules
categories.capstone: Capstone and checklist sign-off: the integrated assessment your preceptor signs
